title: still present since round 4: demo exit from a dirty edit page clears demo state BEFORE the unsaved-changes guard fires
evidence: client.gleam:491-497: `_, True -> case is_public_route(route) { True -> // Exiting the demo must clear every demo-populated store field ... handle_browser_change(model |> model.clear_demo_state, uri, route)`; guard at 5407-5417 runs inside: `routes.VacancyEdit(edit_id), r -> case r { ... _ -> case model.vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes { True -> #(Model(..updated_model, route: model.route, show_unsaved_changes_prompt: True,` and emits `modem.replace("/vacancies/" <> edit_id <> "/edit", None, None)`; that replace lands in the W8 arm 503-507: `_, False -> case is_demo_route(route) { True -> enter_demo(model, route)`; enter_demo's reset field list (5839-5881) sets dropdowns/modals/checkout but NOT show_unsaved_changes_prompt, and demo_entry_effects fires `routes.VacancyEdit(id) -> [demo_api.get_for_edit(store, id, ApiReturnedVacancyForEdit)]`; ApiReturnedVacancyForEdit(Ok) at 1780-1796 unconditionally overwrites the form: `vacancy_property_name: v.property_name, vacancy_address_line_1: v.address_line_1, ... vacancy_monthly_rent: rent_str,`
detail: Dirty demo edit exits to a public route: guard fires on cleared state, URL is replaced back to /edit, W8 re-entry re-seeds and get_for_edit clobbers the dirty form while the prompt is still open.
recommended_fix: Run the dirty-edit guard before clear_demo_state on demo exits, or make enter_demo skip get_for_edit and reset show_unsaved_changes_prompt when a prompt is pending.

title: still present since round 4: demo dispatch arms remain unpinned — refcheck actions, single mark-read, report download, mark-opened threading, get_for_edit deep-link boot

title: still present since round 4: demo comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals write to real web storage — and clear_demo_state omits comparison_ids, so fixture ids survive exit into the real session
evidence: client.gleam:3545-3547 (UserToggledComparison, un-intercepted in demo): `False -> { let new_ids = list.append(ids, [id]) save_comparison_ids(new_ids)`; 6751-6753: `let value = string.join(ids, ",") let _ = storage.set_item(ss, "rt_comparison_ids", value)`; 4949-4953 (UserDismissedSweepNudge): `save_dismissed_sweep_nudges(set.to_list(updated_dismissed))`; clear_demo_state (model.gleam:755-777) resets vacancies..notifications, unread_count but ends `notifications: NotAsked, unread_count: 0, ) }` — no comparison_ids, no dismissed_sweep_nudges; handle_browser_change's Comparison gate then fetches with the stale ids: `routes.Comparison(vid) -> case updated_model.comparison_ids { [] -> #(updated_model, eff) ids -> #(... application_api.fetch_comparison(vid, ids, ApiReturnedComparisonDetails)`,

title: still present since round 4: edit deep-link boot renders the empty editable form for the first frame (no vacancy_edit_loading)

title: still present since round 4: demo boot skips the visibility-refresh listener and localStorage hydrations for the page lifetime
evidence: init demo branch: `True -> { let #(demo_model, demo_eff) = enter_demo(base_model, route) #(demo_model, effect.batch([modem.init(BrowserChangedUrl), demo_eff])) }` vs the False branch batching `auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession), listen_visibility_refresh(), hydrate_dismissed_sweep_nudges_effect(), hydrate_refcheck_explainer_dismissed_effect(),`
detail: A demo-booted tab never installs the visibility /me refresher or the sweep-nudge/refcheck-dismissal hydration, and a logged-in landlord's session is never restored (stash is NotAsked at boot).
recommended_fix: Accepted as intentional for the anonymous demo; document or restore session before demo entry for authed deep links.

title: still present since round 4: deep-link demo boots fire only demo_entry — per-surface analytics undercount the primary entry path
evidence: enter_demo: `Ok(store) -> { demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_entry)` — the only capture; demo_entry_effects contains no capture_event, while the per-surface events (demo_vacancy_open etc.) fire only in handle_browser_change's demo branches (e.g. `True -> { demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_vacancy_open)`).
detail: A /vacancies/v-maples boot counts demo_entry but never demo_vacancy_open, so per-surface funnels undercount deep-link entries vs in-demo navigations.
recommended_fix: Fire the route's surface event inside demo_entry_effects (or enter_demo) alongside demo_entry.

title: still present since round 4: comparison deep link passes persisted real localStorage ids into the demo store, skipping the empty-ids guard
evidence: demo_entry_effects: `routes.Comparison(vid) -> [ demo_api.fetch_comparison( store, vid, load_comparison_ids(), ApiReturnedComparisonDetails, ), ]` — load_comparison_ids() reads the real rt_comparison_ids sessionStorage with no demo filtering.
detail: A real session's selected comparison ids (or leaked fixture ids) flow into the demo store's comparison resolution; unknown ids silently yield an empty comparison surface.
recommended_fix: Pass [] (or filter to store-known fixture ids) for the demo comparison entry fetch.

title: still present since round 4: latent policy re-acceptance modal could surface in demo and fire a real accept_policy POST (UserAcceptedPolicy is EXEMPT_ARMS, not intercepted)
evidence: enter_demo's Model(..) sets auth/csrf/demo fields but never server_policy_version (not in the field list 5819-5881); demo_fixtures.gleam:26 pins the mock landlord `\"accepted_policy_version\":\"2026-05-23\"` with the comment at :28 that it 'matches the current' version; policy_reaccept_required (model.gleam) compares `string.compare(landlord.accepted_policy_version, model.server_policy_version) { order.Lt -> True`.

title: still present since round 4: dead 'routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard' arms in enter_demo/demo_entry_effects — Dashboard never reaches enter_demo
evidence: enter_demo: `vacancies: case route { routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard -> Loading _ -> NotAsked }` and demo_entry_effects: `routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard -> [ demo_api.list_vacancies(store, ApiReturnedDashboardData), ]` — the dispatch sends only routes.Demo to enter_demo (`routes.Demo, False -> enter_demo` and `_, False -> case is_demo_route(route)`, which is False for Dashboard); demo_mode=True + Dashboard goes to `False -> handle_browser_change(model, uri, route)` via is_public_route.
detail: The Dashboard halves of both arms are unreachable; they imply a dashboard-root demo boot path that cannot occur.
recommended_fix: Drop the routes.Dashboard alternatives from both case expressions.
